meta.title: The Radio Repairer
meta.intent: Understand the enduring legacy of a father's patience and craft
meta.logline: A father repairs radios in a small stall, funding his children's education and passing down a philosophy of careful persistence.
meta.style_block: Hand-painted cinematic realism, textured brushstrokes, warm amber and nostalgic sepia tones, soft diffused lighting, highly detailed narrative illustration style.

characters.description: A focused man with gentle eyes, wearing a worn canvas work shirt, holding a tiny screwdriver.

ref.prompt: A close up portrait of a man in his 30s with gentle eyes, wearing a worn canvas work shirt, focused expression.

fact_flags.claim: Father repaired radios and opened a small stall.

locations.description: A cluttered small repair stall filled with vacuum tubes, wires, and old wooden radio cabinets.

ref.prompt: A small cluttered radio repair stall filled with old wooden radios, tools, and spare parts under warm pendant lighting.

fact_flags.claim: He opened his own small repair stall.

shots.purpose: Establish the setting of the market where the father learned his craft as a boy.
shots.visual: An old open-air market stall with vintage radio parts displayed on wooden tables under a canvas awning.
shots.lighting: warm morning sunlight filtering through dust

keyframe.prompt: An old open-air market stall with vintage radio parts on wooden tables under a canvas awning.

motion.prompt: Slow push-in towards the center of the stall.

narration.text: አባቴ ትንሽ ልጅ እያለ ራዲዮ መጠገን ጀመረ።
narration.text_en: My father learned to repair radios when he was a boy.

fact_flags.claim: Father learned to repair radios when he was a boy.

shots.purpose: Show the young boy watching an older man in the market.
shots.visual: A young boy peering intently over a wooden counter as hands carefully solder wires inside an open radio chassis.
shots.subject_move: hands shifting a small soldering iron
shots.lighting: warm directional light on the workbench

keyframe.prompt: A young boy peering intently over a wooden counter as hands solder wires inside an open radio chassis.

motion.prompt: Gentle pan right across the workbench tools.

narration.text: በገበያው ውስጥ አንድ አዛውንት ሲጠግኑ ይመለከት ነበር።
narration.text_en: He watched an older man in the market open them up.

fact_flags.claim: He watched an older man in the market open them up.

shots.purpose: Highlight the collection of broken parts he gathered.
shots.visual: A collection of small metal gears, vacuum tubes, and loose copper wires neatly arranged on a wooden board.

keyframe.prompt: A collection of small metal gears, vacuum tubes, and loose copper wires neatly arranged on a wooden board.

narration.text: ያገኛቸውን የተሰበሩ እቃዎች ሁሉ ይሰበስብ ነበር።
narration.text_en: And he kept every broken part he could find.

fact_flags.claim: He kept every broken part he could find.

shots.purpose: Introduce his own small repair stall in his youth.
shots.visual: The father in his youth standing proudly inside his small, organized repair shop filled with tools.
shots.subject_move: father gently wiping a wooden radio cabinet

keyframe.prompt: A young man in his 30s standing proudly inside his small repair shop filled with tools and wooden radios.

narration.text: ወጣት እያለ የራሱን ትናንሽ የጥገና ሱቅ ከፈተ።
narration.text_en: He opened his own small repair stall when he was young.

fact_flags.claim: He opened his own small repair stall when he was young.

shots.purpose: Show neighbors bringing radios to his shop.
shots.visual: An elderly neighbor handing a dusty, heavy wooden radio across the counter to the smiling repairer.
shots.subject_move: neighbor lifting the radio onto the counter

keyframe.prompt: An elderly neighbor handing a dusty wooden radio across the counter to a smiling repairer.

motion.prompt: Gentle pan left following the handoff.

narration.text: ከሰፈሩ ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ራዲዮአቸውን አመጡለት።
narration.text_en: People brought him radios from the whole neighbourhood.

fact_flags.claim: People brought him radios from the whole neighbourhood.

shots.purpose: Depict his generosity to the elderly on Sunday evenings.
shots.visual: The repairer tinkering with a radio on a quiet Sunday evening, glowing lamp casting warm light on his concentrated face.
shots.subject_move: father turning a dial with tweezers

keyframe.prompt: A repairer tinkering with a radio under a warm desk lamp on a quiet evening.

motion.prompt: Subtle push-in on the hands working.

narration.text: እሁድ ማማ ላይ ለአዛውንቶች ያለ ክፍያ ይጠግንላቸው ነበር።
narration.text_en: And on Sunday evenings he fixed them for free for the old people.

fact_flags.claim: On Sunday evenings he fixed them for free for the old people.

shots.purpose: Connect his hard work to paying for school for the children.
shots.visual: Two young brothers walking together with school books under their arms down a sunlit dirt path.

keyframe.prompt: Two young brothers walking together with school books under their arms down a sunlit dirt path.

motion.prompt: Slow pan right following the walking brothers.

narration.text: በዚያው ስራ ለኔና ለወንድሜ ትምህርት ቤት ክፍያ ከፈለ።
narration.text_en: He paid for my brother and me to go to school with that work.

fact_flags.claim: He paid for my brother and me to go to school with that work.

shots.purpose: Transition to the present day and the narrator's profession.
shots.visual: A modern computer screen glowing in a dim room with lines of software code reflecting on a focused person's glasses.
shots.subject_move: hands typing lightly on a keyboard
shots.lighting: cool screen glow contrasting with warm room ambient

keyframe.prompt: A modern computer screen glowing in a dim room with lines of software code reflecting on a focused worker.

motion.prompt: Subtle pull-back from the glowing screen.

shots.purpose: Show the enduring memory of the father's voice when things break.
shots.visual: A close-up of a vintage vacuum tube glowing softly on a modern desk alongside a laptop, bridging past and present.
shots.subject_move: filament inside the tube glowing slightly brighter

keyframe.prompt: A close-up of a vintage vacuum tube glowing softly on a modern desk alongside a laptop.

motion.prompt: Gentle push-in on the glowing filament.

narration.text: አንዳንዴ ነገር ሲበላሽ ድምጹን እሰማለሁ፤ ከፈተው፣ ታገስ፣ የተበላሸውን ትንሽ ክፍል ፈልግ።
narration.text_en: And when something breaks I still hear him say: open it up, be patient, find the small part that is wrong.

fact_flags.claim: When something breaks I still hear him say: open it up, be patient, find the small part that is wrong.

music.caption: Melancholic and warm acoustic guitar melody with gentle accordion undertones

cues.purpose: Resolve into a reflective, tender modern resonance
